findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: The chlorine sanitizer being used is a lavender scented variant. The PIC was instructed to have non-scented sanitizer prior to the next routine inspection. Inspectors will follow up either at the 6/25/26 at Rochester Sports in the Park.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: An employee drink is observed mixed in with the single service boats. The drink was moved to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The potato slicer is observed with soiled with food debris. Per the PIC this equipment has not been used today. he equipment was disassembled and cleaned during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
A spatula was observed in the hand washing sink.  Discussed with PIC, it was removed immediately.  Ensure the hand washing sink is only used for hand washing.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
